_note: The Stagwell network, PRE-FETCHED. When a visitor gives an address we already know these — no lookup, no model, no latency, and nothing that can be invented about them. A match means the person is inside the network rather than a prospect, and the conversation says so. Everything here is the client's own research document, verbatim; `based` and `summary` are its words. It carries no headcount and no competitors, so those stay null and the flow asks as usual.
source: Stagwell Companies, Agencies & Platforms — Domain Reference, compiled September 2026 (client, 2026-09-17)
caveat: The 53 domains in the client's working list, not every legal subsidiary. Some listed brands have been merged or reorganised while their domains remain active, and Stagwell has businesses not represented here. For legal ownership, the SEC filings are the authority, not this file.

companies.name: Stagwell
companies.summary: Stagwell is a publicly traded, digital-first global marketing network that combines creative agencies, media, research, digital transformation, public affairs, communications, and marketing technology. The company describes itself as a challenger holding company focused on “harmonizing the art and science of marketing.” Its network includes 70+ agencies operating across more than 30 countries and serving thousands of clients globally.

companies.name: The Marketing Cloud
companies.summary: The Marketing Cloud is Stagwell’s suite of self-service and technology-enabled marketing products. Rather than functioning like a traditional advertising agency, it packages software and data products for research, media, audience targeting, influencer marketing, communications intelligence, and AI-assisted marketing workflows.

companies.name: 72andSunny
companies.based: Los Angeles, United States; global offices
companies.summary: 72andSunny is a full-service creative agency known for large brand platforms, advertising campaigns, design, strategy, and culturally driven marketing. Founded in 2004, the agency has worked with major global brands across technology, entertainment, consumer goods, sports, and automotive categories.

companies.name: ACE
companies.summary: ACE is a content development and production company that creates premium original entertainment and branded content. Its work spans feature films, episodic television, publishing, digital and social content, and experiential or live events.

companies.name: Activista
companies.summary: Activista is a purpose-driven creative company focused on advertising and ideas designed to influence behavior and generate social or cultural impact. Its positioning emphasizes work intended to create positive change rather than conventional campaign output alone.

companies.name: Allison
companies.based: San Francisco, United States; global network
companies.summary: Allison is a global integrated marketing and communications consultancy. It works across public relations, corporate communications, consumer marketing, reputation, influencer relations, digital, social, healthcare, technology, and brand strategy.

companies.name: Anomaly
companies.based: New York, United States; global offices
companies.summary: Anomaly is a global creative agency founded around a “new model” approach that extends beyond traditional advertising. Its capabilities have included brand strategy, creative, innovation, product development, entertainment, intellectual property, consulting, and business-building.

companies.name: Assembly
companies.summary: Assembly is a global omnichannel media agency focused on media planning and buying, performance marketing, data, technology, commerce, and business consulting. It works with large international brands and combines media execution with analytics and technology.

companies.name: Bobbie
companies.summary: Bobbie is a creator and influencer marketing agency launched by Stagwell agency HUNTER in 2025. It provides end-to-end influencer campaigns, ambassador programs, affiliate marketing, creator content, events, and creator strategy.

companies.name: Brand New Galaxy
companies.summary: Brand New Galaxy is a digital commerce and transformation group with roots in Poland. It helps brands manage e-commerce, digital marketing, content, retail media, technology, and the digital path to purchase.

companies.name: Bruce Mau Design
companies.summary: Bruce Mau Design, commonly known as BMD, is a branding and design consultancy associated with designer Bruce Mau’s design philosophy and legacy. The firm works on brand strategy, visual identity, experience design, organizational purpose, and brand systems.

companies.name: Code and Theory
companies.based: New York, United States; global network
companies.summary: Code and Theory is Stagwell’s flagship digital transformation agency and the center of the Code and Theory Network. It brings together strategy, design, creative, engineering, data, product, and technology, with Stagwell emphasizing its roughly balanced mix of creatives and engineers.

companies.name: Colle McVoy
companies.summary: Colle McVoy is a full-service creative agency with a long history in the Minneapolis market. Its work spans brand strategy, advertising, digital, media, design, experience, and integrated marketing.

companies.name: Consulum
companies.based: Middle East / London; major offices in Riyadh and Dubai
companies.summary: Consulum is a strategic advisory and communications firm focused primarily on governments, national institutions, and senior public-sector leaders. Founded in 2013, it shifted to an exclusively government-focused model in 2018.

companies.name: Create. Group
companies.summary: Create. Group is a Middle Eastern strategic digital communications group with teams across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Egypt.

companies.name: Crispin
companies.based: United States; historically Boulder/Miami, now multi-office
companies.summary: Crispin, formerly widely known as Crispin Porter + Bogusky or CP+B, is one of the advertising industry’s most recognized creative agency brands. Founded in 1965, it became famous for unconventional campaigns and has expanded into integrated creative, media, research, strategy, analytics, and performance marketing.

companies.name: Doner
companies.summary: Doner is a full-service advertising agency founded in 1937 and known for strategy, creative, brand advertising, digital, production, and integrated campaigns. The company has deep roots in Detroit and a long history working with large consumer and retail brands.

companies.name: DonerNorth
companies.summary: DonerNorth is a Canadian integrated creative agency affiliated with the Doner network. It develops advertising, brand strategy, digital, customer journey, content, and integrated marketing programs.

companies.name: Dyversity Communications
companies.summary: Dyversity Communications is a Canadian multicultural advertising and marketing agency. Its specialization is helping brands communicate with ethnically and culturally diverse audiences in Canada through culturally relevant strategy, creative, media, and communications.

companies.name: Emerald Research Group
companies.summary: Emerald Research Group is a market research and insights firm combining quantitative and qualitative research with data science and business strategy. Its work is designed not just to generate research findings but to translate them into decisions that can be used inside client organizations.

companies.name: Forsman & Bodenfors
companies.summary: Forsman & Bodenfors is a global creative collective founded in Sweden in 1986. It is known for highly collaborative creative work and has been recognized internationally for advertising, brand strategy, design, and integrated campaigns.

companies.name: GALE
companies.based: New York, United States; international offices
companies.summary: GALE is a data-led business, creative, media, and marketing consultancy. It brings together audience data, analytics, customer experience, creative strategy, media, CRM, and technology.

companies.name: Goodstuff
companies.summary: Goodstuff is a UK media planning and buying agency. It is known for independent-agency roots, communications planning, media strategy, buying, and inventive use of media channels.

companies.name: F&B Happy
companies.summary: F&B Happy is associated with the Forsman & Bodenfors creative collective in Sweden. The business operates in the creative and brand communications space and shares the broader F&B culture of collaborative, design- and idea-led work.

companies.name: HarrisX
companies.summary: HarrisX is a market research and analytics business specializing in telecommunications, media, technology, connected consumers, and public opinion. It combines survey research with behavioral data to study how people use devices, platforms, media, and technology.

companies.name: HUNTER
companies.summary: HUNTER is an integrated consumer marketing communications and public relations agency with major operations in New York, Los Angeles, and London. Its capabilities include earned media, brand communications, social, influencer marketing, experiential work, research, and integrated campaigns.

companies.name: Ink
companies.summary: Ink is a travel media company that works with airlines, airports, and travel brands. Historically known for inflight publishing, it has expanded into digital media, advertising, content, audience monetization, and travel-focused media products.

companies.name: Instrument
companies.based: Portland, Oregon, United States; additional U.S. offices
companies.summary: Instrument is a technology-led brand, digital product, experience, and marketing agency. It works at the intersection of design and technology, helping companies create digital products, platforms, brand experiences, and campaigns.

companies.name: Kenna
companies.summary: Kenna is a business-to-business marketing solutions company specializing in customer experience and relationship management. Founded in 1985, it combines data, technology, CRM, analytics, marketing, sales enablement, and customer engagement.

companies.name: KWT Global
companies.summary: KWT Global has historically operated as an integrated communications and public relations agency within the Stagwell/MDC ecosystem. Its work has included corporate communications, consumer PR, digital, social, influencer strategy, content, and reputation management.

companies.name: Left Field Labs
companies.summary: Left Field Labs is a creative technology and digital transformation agency combining engineering, design, strategy, emerging technology, and experiential development. Founded in Venice Beach, it has worked on AI, 5G, connected experiences, prototypes, platforms, and digital products for large technology and consumer companies.

companies.name: Locaria
companies.summary: Locaria is a global content, language, localization, and multilingual marketing agency. It helps brands adapt content, search, creative, media, and digital experiences for different languages and markets.

companies.name: Mediacurrent
companies.summary: Mediacurrent is a digital experience and web technology agency that designs, builds, maintains, optimizes, and supports websites, applications, and digital platforms. Founded in 2007, it has deep experience in content management and open-source technology, particularly Drupal.

companies.name: MMI Agency
companies.summary: MMI has operated as an integrated media, marketing, communications, and performance agency. Its expertise has included media strategy, planning and buying, performance marketing, public relations, influencer marketing, analytics, and creative content.

companies.name: MONO
companies.summary: MONO is a design-driven advertising and branding agency. Its philosophy centers on simplicity, design thinking, and helping organizations invent or reinvent brands and businesses.

companies.name: Movers+Shakers
companies.based: Los Angeles and New York, United States
companies.summary: Movers+Shakers is a creative agency known for social-first, culture-driven work aimed particularly at Gen Z and Millennial audiences. It specializes in helping brands become culturally relevant through TikTok, social platforms, creators, content, music, and emerging formats.

companies.name: Multiview
companies.summary: Multiview is a business-to-business digital media and advertising company. It uses first-party audience data covering millions of B2B professionals across dozens of industries to help advertisers reach specific professional audiences.

companies.name: National Research Group
companies.based: Los Angeles, United States; global offices
companies.summary: National Research Group, commonly called NRG, is an insights and strategy company focused heavily on entertainment, media, technology, gaming, content, and consumer behavior. The firm has decades of experience testing entertainment concepts, measuring audiences, and advising media and technology companies on strategy, positioning, content, and growth.

companies.name: PRophet
companies.based: New York, United States; global technology platform
companies.summary: PRophet is an AI-powered communications technology platform created within Stagwell’s communications ecosystem. It uses artificial intelligence to assist PR professionals with media discovery, journalist targeting, message testing, content development, pitching, and communications workflows.

companies.name: Redscout
companies.summary: Redscout is a brand innovation consultancy that works on brand strategy, innovation, new products, customer experience, culture, and organizational transformation. Rather than focusing primarily on advertising execution, it helps clients determine what to build, how brands should evolve, and where new growth opportunities exist.

companies.name: SKDK
companies.based: Washington, D.C. and New York, United States
companies.summary: SKDK is a strategic communications and public affairs firm. It works with corporations, nonprofits, advocacy groups, philanthropies, labor organizations, political committees, and candidates on communications strategy, media relations, crisis management, public affairs, advertising, and issue advocacy.

companies.name: Sloane & Company
companies.summary: Sloane & Company is a strategic corporate and financial communications firm focused on the intersection of reputation and valuation. Its services include corporate communications, financial communications, transaction and M&A communications, crisis and issues management, investor-related communications, and executive positioning.

companies.name: Targeted Victory
companies.based: Arlington, Virginia / Washington, D.C. area, United States
companies.summary: Targeted Victory is a digital strategy, advertising, fundraising, and audience activation company with deep roots in political and advocacy marketing. Its capabilities include paid media, digital advertising, fundraising, data, analytics, creative, and campaign technology.

companies.name: The Harris Poll
companies.summary: The Harris Poll is one of the longest-running public opinion and market research organizations in the United States, tracing its polling work to 1963. It tracks public sentiment, social trends, brand reputation, consumer behavior, and corporate reputation.

companies.name: Truelogic
companies.based: Latin America / United States-facing distributed operations
companies.summary: Truelogic is a nearshore software engineering and technology services company specializing in building and scaling development teams for clients. It connects North American companies with engineering talent across Latin America and supports software development, digital products, cloud, data, and technology transformation.

companies.name: Veritas
companies.summary: Veritas is a Canadian integrated public relations, communications, and brand reputation agency. Its work sits between PR, corporate communications, reputation, marketing, influencer strategy, and stakeholder communications.

companies.name: Kettle
companies.summary: Kettle is a digital creative agency working at the intersection of design and technology. Its work includes websites, digital products, e-commerce, campaigns, platforms, and content-driven digital experiences.

companies.name: TEAM
companies.based: Fort Lauderdale, Florida, United States; nationwide operations
companies.summary: TEAM is an experiential marketing agency focused on live brand experiences, field marketing, events, sampling, activations, and consumer engagement. Stagwell says the company helps bring more than 100,000 brand activations to life each year.

companies.name: Wolfgang L.A.
companies.summary: Wolfgang L.A. is a creative consultancy and advertising agency positioned between traditional management consulting and creative advertising.

companies.name: Yamamoto
companies.summary: Yamamoto is a full-service creative agency founded in 1979. It works on brand strategy, advertising, identity, integrated campaigns, digital, and creative communications.

companies.name: BERA.ai
companies.summary: BERA.ai is a brand intelligence and predictive analytics platform designed to connect brand performance with business outcomes. It uses large-scale brand and consumer data to help marketers understand brand equity, momentum, category performance, and potential financial impact.

companies.name: InfluencerMarketing.ai / IMAI
companies.based: Global; technology operations associated with LEADERS / Stagwell
companies.summary: InfluencerMarketing.ai, commonly shortened to IMAI, is an influencer discovery, campaign management, analytics, and creator marketing platform. It provides access to large creator databases and tools for searching creators, evaluating audience quality, managing campaigns, measuring results, and supporting influencer workflows.

companies.name: UNICEPTA
companies.summary: UNICEPTA is a global media intelligence, monitoring, reputation analytics, and communications insights company. Headquartered in Cologne, it operates across multiple countries with offices including Berlin, London, Paris, São Paulo, Shanghai, Washington, D.C., and Zurich.
